Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 행정안전부. Its tags are 정화조, 오수처리, 하수처리, 오수처리시설, 하수처리시설. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
